records.text: The Stratos project will deliver thousands of jobs.
records.speaker: Kevin O'Leary

appearances.snippet: O'Leary (Kevin O'Leary) has claimed that Stratos will deliver thousands of jobs.

verification.notes: Official county forecasts project thousands of temporary construction jobs and 1,000 to 2,000 permanent jobs, confirming the prediction was made. Full construction is not approved and the jobs have not yet been delivered, so the future outcome cannot yet be verified.

records.text: Most protesters against the Stratos project do not live locally and were paid to object.
records.speaker: Kevin O'Leary

appearances.snippet: O'Leary (Kevin O'Leary) has claimed in social media posts that most of the protesters don't live locally and have been paid to object to the project.

verification.notes: Transcript context attributes this to Kevin OLeary. Public reporting confirms he alleged opponents were out-of-state and paid, but no evidence was offered and no reliable source substantiates that most protesters were nonlocal or compensated.

records.text: High-resolution video surveillance is built into every street corner and is how many crimes are solved.
records.speaker: Kevin O'Leary

appearances.snippet: I would say now with the amount of high resolution video and surveillance that is built into every street corner. ... That's how they solve a lot of crimes.

verification.notes: Video surveillance is widespread and often assists investigations, but the universal claim that high-resolution surveillance is built into every street corner has no defined jurisdiction and no authoritative nationwide evidence. No-result research is not a basis for marking it false.

records.text: AI-enhanced facial-recognition technology has reached the resolution that enables airport identity processing in Dubai and some U.S. airports.
records.speaker: Kevin O'Leary

appearances.snippet: is a great issue, but the enhancement of surveillance with AI tools is how you now walk through. ... the dubai airport and you also walk through some airports here in the u.s facial recognition technology has finally got to the resolution using ai's tools where

verification.notes: CBP currently uses biometric facial comparison to process travelers at hundreds of U.S. airports, including touchless identity checks. Emirates and Dubai authorities document facial and iris recognition for check-in, immigration, lounge access, and boarding at Dubai International.
